questions.question: For the historical portrait of George David Birkhoff, identify a public original source, the photographer or creator where known, and a confirmed legal basis for publication. Authorship of the article and possession of a copy do not grant rights in a third-party photograph.

questions.question: Correct the definition of a dynamical system: it is a state space together with a law of evolution in time, not a set of elements with a relationship between time and the position of each element.

localizations.source: Correct the definition of a dynamical system: it is a state space together with a law of evolution in time, not a set of elements with a relationship between time and the position of each element.
localizations.ru: Исправить определение динамической системы: это пространство состояний вместе с законом эволюции во времени, а не множество элементов с зависимостью между временем и положением каждого элемента.
